answer: I would stop farms with work permit hash with labour authority attestation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 7293 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. What carries the spiral here is verification, the whisper of cost is what stops the farm, and the willow of the record keeps every claim checkable. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
